spec_dod.text: `clusterback backup analytics-db` produces a snapshot `snap-2026-03` and `clusterback verify snap-2026-03` confirms it is restorable.
`clusterback restore snap-2026-03` into a fresh target reproduces `analytics-db`'s row counts exactly as they were at backup time.
A backup taken while a write is mid-transaction never captures a partially-committed row (the snapshot is transactionally consistent).
Restoring `snap-2026-03` into an already-populated target refuses by default (no silent overwrite) unless an explicit `--force` is given.
The restore tool's confirmation prompt makes the blast radius of the operation clear before it runs.

clusterback restore snap-2026-03 into fresh target
